## Thread 2 — `thread-568cd4c46cad825d4135531b` (Maya, Devon, Me)

**Tentative plan: see the ducks at the pond, Saturday morning ~9am.**

| Time (EDT) | Speaker | Message |
|---|---|---|
| 18:30:00 | Maya | "ugh traffic getting home tonight was the worst" |
| 18:37:37 | Maya | "random thought tho, anyone want to go see the ducks at the pond Saturday morning?" |
| 18:39:54 | Devon | "ohh yes I haven't done that in forever" |
| 18:40:17 | Devon | "what time were you thinking?" |
| 18:40:28 | Me | "hmm maybe, my Saturday is kind of up in the air rn" |
| 18:40:51 | Maya | "I was thinking like 9am before it gets too hot?" |
| 18:41:14 | Devon | "yeah that works for me" |
| 18:42:00 | Me | "9 is early lol I'll have to see, don't plan around me" |
| 18:49:37 | Maya | "haha no worries just lmk" |
| 18:50:00 | Devon | "did your guys power flicker earlier or was that just my building" |

Key details:
- Activity: **seeing the ducks at the pond**, Saturday morning.
- Proposed time: **9:00 am** (Maya's rationale: "before it gets too hot").
- Devon: confirmed availability ("yeah that works for me").
- Me (owner): **not committed** — Saturday "kind of up in the air," said "don't plan around me"; Maya replied "no worries just lmk" → **owner owes a decision**.
- Devon's last message asks whether the others' power flickered earlier or if it was just their building — **unanswered** in the log.

- Friday 7pm — meet Devon at Luigi's on 5th.
- Decide whether to join the Saturday 9am pond/duck outing and let Maya know.
- Optional: respond to Devon's question about the power flicker.
